key.title: Enter your library key
key.body: Type the 12 words you saved when you created your library.
key.saved: Your library key is saved on this phone.

errors.unavailable: Can't check the key right now. Check your connection and try again.

album.noPlayableFile: This album has no playable file yet.

signOutKey.title: Have you saved your library key?
signOutKey.body: Signing out removes your library key from this phone. To sign back in you will have to type it, because signing in with a QR code only works while another of your devices still has the key. Without the key, your library can't be opened.

setup.notificationsBody: Parrot can tell you when the music you add from your computer is ready to play here.

tvSearch.hint: Results change with each letter. Press ▶ on the remote to move from the keys to the results.

kept.chooseBody: These songs are stored in more than one format. Pick the one to keep on this phone.
kept.failed: Couldn't keep this on your phone. Try again.

empty.title: Add your first album
empty.subtitle: Add music with Parrot on your computer. It shows up here by itself.
empty.step1Body: In Parrot on your computer, choose song files or a whole folder. Nothing leaves it until you say so.
empty.step2Body: Covers, artist pictures and lyrics arrive by themselves.
empty.step3Body: This phone and your computers play the same library, encrypted with your key.
